name: Joela
title: One of David's Mighty Men
summary: Joela was one of the brave warriors who joined David while he was fleeing from King Saul. He is mentioned among the skilled soldiers from the tribe of Gad who came to David at the fortress in the wilderness. These men were known for their military prowess and courage.

keyEvents.title: Listed Among David's Mighty Men from Gad
keyEvents.description: Joela is mentioned among the brave warriors from the tribe of Gad who went to David at the fortress in the wilderness. These men were skilled soldiers, ready for battle.

keyEvents.title: Description of the Fighting Skills of the Gadites
keyEvents.description: The Gadites who joined David are described as men with faces like lions and swift as gazelles on the mountains. They were trained for war with shield and spear.

keyEvents.title: The Gadites Cross the Jordan
keyEvents.description: These warriors from Gad crossed the Jordan in the first month when the river overflowed all its banks, demonstrating their courage and determination.

keyEvents.title: David's Growing Army
keyEvents.description: Joela and the other warriors contributed to David's army growing into a mighty force that eventually helped him become king over all Israel.
